# Vendored libc++ for legacy iOS (armv7, iPhoneOS5.0.sdk)

The iOS 5 system `libc++.dylib` exports only the symbols its era's headers
referenced (~2000), so modern C++17 code fails to link against it. This
directory vendors the **LLVM 19.1.7 libc++** and builds it as a *static*
runtime linked ahead of `-lc++abi`, giving the game a complete C++17 standard
library with zero dependency on the ancient dylib.

## Layout

```
include/            LLVM 19.1.7 libc++ headers + hand-written __config_site /
                    __assertion_handler (normally generated by CMake)
src/upstream/       library sources copied verbatim from llvm-project/libcxx/src
src/upstream/filesystem/  + their private quoted-include headers
src/filesystem/ios_operations_backport.cpp
                    std::filesystem's library side reimplemented with plain
                    POSIX — upstream needs openat()/fdopendir(), which the
                    iPhoneOS5.0.sdk predates
src/chrono-ios.cpp  chrono.cpp patched: no public clock_gettime on iOS < 10,
                    steady clock uses mach_absolute_time()
src/future_stub.cpp thread.cpp pulls one symbol from future.o; upstream's
                    future.cpp needs __cxa_init_primary_exception (absent from
                    the old libc++abi) and nothing in the port uses futures
src/cxa_shims.cpp   __cxa_bad_typeid / __cxa_bad_cast — raised by typeid /
                    dynamic_cast on null objects; missing from old libc++abi
```

## Build notes (see CMakeLists.txt `MC_IOS` branch)

- Compiled as C++20 (library sources use `constinit`) while consumers use C++17.
- **No `-fno-rtti`:** the exception classes' typeinfo/vtables must be emitted
  here because the system libc++abi.dylib lacks them.
- `_LIBCPP_PSTL_BACKEND_SERIAL` selects the serial parallel-algorithms backend.
- Excluded from the build: `barrier.cpp` `charconv.cpp` `expected.cpp`
  `random_shuffle.cpp` (C++20/23 features or APIs unused by this port).
- The file clock is nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, matching upstream's
  `filesystem_clock.cpp`.

## Regenerating

Sources came from a sparse clone of llvm-project @ llvmorg-19.1.7:

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --branch llvmorg-19.1.7 --filter=blob:none --sparse \
    https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git
git -C llvm-project sparse-checkout set libcxx/include libcxx/src libcxxabi/include
```

`__config_site` sets: ABI v1 (`__1` namespace), hardening NONE, no vendor
availability annotations (they would mark std::filesystem unavailable below
iOS 13), no aligned_alloc (falls back to posix_memalign).
